summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder did not authorise the 1,240.50 EUR charge of 1 April 2025 and suggests their card details were compromised.
summary.to_defend: Mastercard requires any two of: full AVS plus CVV match, successful Identity Check authentication, two prior undisputed transactions, or signed proof of delivery to the billing address.

requirements.title: AVS and CVV match
requirements.text: AVS match (full address) AND CVV match on the disputed transaction.
requirements.finding: Transaction metadata records avs_result Y (full address match) and cvv_result M (match), and the gateway authorisation log for txn_4412EF confirms both checks passed at authorisation.

citations.quote:
AVS check (full address)
Y
Full match

requirements.title: 3DS authenticated
requirements.text: 3D Secure authentication completed successfully (Mastercard SecureCode / Identity Check).
requirements.finding: Mastercard Identity Check completed successfully for txn_4412EF with ECI 02, an authentication value present and a DS transaction ID, authenticated frictionlessly by the issuer BNP Paribas at 11:08:18 UTC on 1 April 2025.

requirements.title: Two prior undisputed transactions
requirements.text: Two prior undisputed transactions from the same cardholder with this merchant in the past 12 months, with matching billing details.
requirements.finding: No record of any prior transaction by this cardholder with Velo Continental Rentals was supplied; the only related datum is a device fingerprint noted as a "Returning device (seen 3x)", which does not identify two prior undisputed transactions or matching billing details.
requirements.gap: No transaction history listing two prior undisputed purchases in the past 12 months with matching billing details.

requirements.title: Signed delivery to billing address
requirements.text: Proof of delivery to the cardholder's billing address with signature.
requirements.finding: MCC 7512 is vehicle rental and the record shows a rental service rather than a shipped item, so there is no consignment that could carry signed proof of delivery to the billing address.

reasons: Every requirement the decision relies on is backed by verified evidence

checks.label: Key evidence comes from document text, not only from an image
Images the evidence relies on are fully legible
Every quoted passage was found in the documents
The rule check and the AI recommendation agree

justification: Represent: R1 (full AVS and CVV match) and R2 (successful Identity Check authentication) are both satisfied, meeting the any-two threshold for 4837.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the 1,240.50 EUR charge of 1 April 2025 (txn_4412EF) was not authorised by the cardholder.
The gateway authorisation log shows a full address AVS match (Y) and a CVV match (M) on that same transaction.
Mastercard Identity Check authenticated the cardholder frictionlessly at 11:08:18 UTC on 1 April 2025, ECI 02, authentication value present, DS transaction ID ds_4b2e1100c4, issuer BNP Paribas.
Billing and shipping postcodes both read 75011 and the Paris IP 90.84.21.117 is consistent with an FR-issued card.
Two of the four requirements are satisfied, so the case meets the threshold to represent.
